content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and advisory services firm; it does not manage client investment portfolios for fees like Silvercrest."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment management through funds and separate accounts for institutions and individuals, closely matching Silvercrest's model."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Registered adviser managing separate accounts and funds in equity and fixed income for advisors, institutions and individuals."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Investment management through mutual funds and separately managed accounts for individuals, institutions and foundations, earning asset-based fees."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Alternatives platform selling hedge, private equity and private credit funds to institutions, unlike Silvercrest's wealth management for affluent families."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account custody and employer benefits administration; a healthcare benefits business, not investment management."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Software and outsourced back-office operations sold to financial firms; it does not provide investment management to clients."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing property, casualty and benefits coverage with carriers; a different business from investment management."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Property and construction management services for publicly traded REITs; real estate operations rather than investment advisory for wealthy clients."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Investment management through affiliated boutique managers, selling funds and separate accounts via advisers to individuals and institutions."}]}
